headline: Executive order aimed at strengthening adult education programs run by the federal government.
what_it_does: This 2007 order from President George W. Bush focuses on improving adult education, such as reading, math, and English-language skills for adults. No official summary was provided, so the specific details are not covered here. Generally, orders like this direct federal agencies to coordinate their adult education efforts and look for ways to improve them.

who_it_affects.group: Adults seeking basic education or English-language skills
who_it_affects.how: Federal adult education programs they may use could be reviewed or better coordinated under the order.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run adult education programs
who_it_affects.how: They may be directed to work together on improving how these programs operate.
